title: What Accuracy Hides In Learned Transformer Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.22891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code. TP expose learned computations, but token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers. In this work, we examine how program inspection provides insights beyond accuracy scores and helps guide training. We first evaluated TP on nine algorithmic tasks. We compared token accuracy with accuracy on complete output sequences and checked for failures missed by sampled tests. Further, we assessed training data improvements informed by program inspection and failure analysis, finding gains in sequence accuracy on several tasks. We examined a counting task where a program achieved 100% accuracy on sampled test sequences but failed on another input using the symbols and lengths allowed during training. The program counted correctly, but the required answer was missing from its output lab

translated_title: 已学习的Transformer程序中准确率掩盖了什么
translated_abstract: Transformer程序（TP）（Friedman等人，2023）通过约束Transformer的架构，使其学习到的计算能够被提取为可读的Python代码。TP能够暴露模型学习到的计算过程，但token准确率可能会掩盖不正确的完整答案。在这项工作中，我们研究了程序检查如何提供超越准确率分数的洞察，并帮助指导训练。我们首先在九个算法任务上评估了TP，将token准确率与完整输出序列的准确率进行比较，并检查了被抽样测试所遗漏的失败案例。此外，我们评估了基于程序检查和失败分析所改进的训练数据，发现多个任务的序列准确率得到了提升。我们研究了一个计数任务，其中一个程序在抽样测试序列上达到了100%的准确率，但在一个使用训练期间允许的符号和长度的其他输入上却失败了。该程序的计数是正确的，但所需的答案在其输出标签中缺失……
tldr: 该研究发现token准确率会掩盖Transformer程序中的错误完整答案，通过程序检查能够发现抽样测试遗漏的失败案例，并据此改进训练数据，从而在多个算法任务上提升序列准确率。
en_tdlr: Token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers in Transformer Programs; program inspection reveals failures missed by sampled tests and guides training data improvements, yielding sequence accuracy gains on several tasks.
